ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from manually selecting "Being Referred" as it should only be triggered by the "Refer Lead" button.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISPICKVAL(Status, "Being Referred"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Being Referred")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The "Being Referred" status can only be set via the "Refer Lead" button.
